READABILITY.evidence: There is no real implementation. src/main.zig is still the scaffold stub ("Stub implementation... Replace this with a real implementation", a TODO in swscale_process). There is no conversion logic to read.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: The diff commits build artifacts: the .zig-cache/ files, the zig-out/lib/libswscale_candidate.so binary and the cache .o files. The only source is the unchanged stub, with none of the kernel families or shared helpers the conventions call for.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: swscale_process always returns -1, so it never converts anything. swscale_create never checks src_fmt, dst_fmt, algo or sizes and returns a context for any configuration.

C6-07-CASE1.evidence: No kernels were written. Tails, strides, scaling and tiny frames are all unhandled, and swscale_create never returns NULL for unsupported combinations. Hidden tests failed correctness.

C6-07-CASE2.evidence: The three symbols are exported, but swscale_process never returns 0. build.zig uses standardTargetOptions and does not set x86-64-v3; its comment says to pass "-Dcpu=x86_64_v3" on the command line.
